data.name: Santosh
data.gender_notes: Santosh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'fully', + tuṣ, 'to be satisfied' — 'contentment'. Its root is Sanskrit saṃ + tuṣ. A classical Sanskrit term for contentment. Santosh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Contentment; satisfaction”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Santosh expresses “Contentment; satisfaction”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'fully', + tuṣ, 'to be satisfied' — 'contentment'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Santosh total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

vedic_reference.note: The name Santosh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Santosha', which is used in various Hindu scriptures and texts, including the Vedas and the Upanishads. It is also mentioned in several Puranas and epics, such as the Mahabharata and the Ramayana.
